import {
  createAgreement, parseTrace, parseTasks, parseSpec, extractTestRequirements, VERIFY_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION, loadParserSchemas, TRACE_SCHEMA_VERSION, SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION, TASKS_SCHEMA_VERSION, loadTraceSchemas, type Evidence as CoreEvidence, type EvidenceDocument as CoreEvidenceDocument, type Report as CoreReport, type ReportRow as CoreReportRow,
  QUALITY_REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION, loadQualityReportSchema, type QualityReport,
  type ParseError, type Trace, type LedgerRow, type QuestionRow, type AssumptionRow, type SpecOperation, type SpecRequirement, type Task, type VerifyResult, type VerifyCheckResult,
} from '@loomake/core';
import { evaluateAgreement, evaluateTestCoverage, type AgreementDecision, type TestCoverageDecision, runVerify, formatVerifyResult, UsageError, type VerifyOptions } from '@loomake/kit';
import { runRecord, runReport, buildReport, EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION, type Evidence, type EvidenceDocument, type Report, type ReportRow } from '@loomake/trace';
import { runRun, maskSecrets, type RunOptions, type RunSummary } from '@loomake/runner';

type Equal<A, B> = (<T>() => T extends A ? 1 : 2) extends (<T>() => T extends B ? 1 : 2) ? true : false;
type Assert<T extends true> = T;
export type StatusContract = Assert<Equal<VerifyCheckResult['status'], 'pass' | 'fail' | 'warn' | 'skip'>>;

// 型チェックだけに使う利用側の例。呼び出してファイルやGitを変更しない。
export function consumePublicApi(root: string) {
  const error: ParseError = { file: 'trace.md', line: 1, message: '入力の確認' };
  const trace: Trace = parseTrace(error.file, '').value;
  const tasks: Task[] = parseTasks('tasks.md', '- [ ] task').value;
  const checked: boolean = tasks[0].checked;
  const specs = parseSpec('spec.md', '').value;
  const ids: Record<string, string[]> = extractTestRequirements('report.json', '{}').value;
  const verification: VerifyResult = { schemaVersion: VERIFY_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION, mode: 'done', change: 'sample', ok: true, results: [] };
  const ok: boolean = verification.ok;
  const options: VerifyOptions = { root, changeId: 'sample', gate: 'spec-only' };
  const verified: VerifyResult = runVerify(options);
  const text: string = formatVerifyResult(verified);
  const oldEvidence: Evidence = { schemaVersion: EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION, change: 'sample', sha: 'a', committedAt: '', recordedAt: '', verify: verification };
  const recorded: number = runRecord({ root, changeId: 'sample', stdout: () => {} });
  const reported: number = runReport({ root, changeId: 'sample', format: 'json', stdout: () => {} });
  const report: Report | undefined = buildReport(root, 'sample');
  const runOptions: RunOptions = { root, changeId: 'sample', interactive: false, confirm: async () => false, stdout: () => {} };
  const running: Promise<number> = runRun(runOptions);
  const summary: RunSummary = { change: 'sample', status: 'interrupted', reason: '', doneTasks: [], remainingTasks: [], lastVerify: null };
  const masked: string = maskSecrets(text);
  return { trace, checked, specs, ids, ok, oldEvidence, recorded, reported, report, running, summary, masked, error: new UsageError('設定の確認') };
}

// @ts-expect-error REQ-148: coreでは判定関数と結果型を公開しない。
import { evaluateAgreement as removedAgreement, type AgreementDecision as RemovedAgreement } from '@loomake/core';
// @ts-expect-error REQ-149: coreでは判定関数と結果型を公開しない。
import { evaluateTestCoverage as removedCoverage, type TestCoverageDecision as RemovedCoverage } from '@loomake/core';
export function consumePolicyApi(trace: Trace): [AgreementDecision, TestCoverageDecision] {
  return [evaluateAgreement(createAgreement('trace.md', trace).value), evaluateTestCoverage(['REQ-148'], {})];
}

// REQ-298・REQ-299: 配布されたスキーマ由来の型と遅延 loader だけを使う。
export async function consumeParserContracts(trace: Trace, spec: SpecRequirement[], tasks: Task[]) {
  const schemas = await loadParserSchemas();
  const versions: ['1.0.0', '1.0.0', '1.0.0'] = [TRACE_SCHEMA_VERSION, SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION, TASKS_SCHEMA_VERSION];
  const ledger: LedgerRow[] = schemas.traceSchema.parse(trace).ledger;
  const questions: QuestionRow[] = trace.questions;
  const assumptions: AssumptionRow[] = trace.assumptions;
  const operation: SpecOperation | null = schemas.specSchema.parse(spec)[0].op;
  const parsedTasks: Task[] = schemas.tasksSchema.parse(tasks);
  return { versions, ledger, questions, assumptions, operation, parsedTasks };
}

// REQ-302・REQ-303・REQ-304: 従来の公開元と導出型を同じ配布物から使う。
export async function consumeTraceContracts(evidence: Evidence, document: EvidenceDocument, report: Report, row: ReportRow) {
  const schemas = await loadTraceSchemas();
  const futureEvidence: CoreEvidence = { ...evidence, schemaVersion: 9.5 };
  const futureReport: CoreReport = { ...report, schemaVersion: -1 };
  const saved: CoreEvidenceDocument = schemas.evidenceDocumentSchema.parse(document);
  const result: CoreReportRow = schemas.reportRowSchema.parse(row);
  const oldEvidence: Evidence = schemas.evidenceSchema.parse(futureEvidence);
  const oldReport: Report = schemas.reportSchema.parse(futureReport);
  return { saved, result, oldEvidence, oldReport };
}

export async function consumeQualityReportContract(input: unknown): Promise<QualityReport> {
  const version: 1 = QUALITY_REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION;
  const { qualityReportSchema } = await loadQualityReportSchema();
  const result: QualityReport = qualityReportSchema.parse(input);
  return { ...result, version };
}
